database.stem: ------- Mr. Bingham’s promotion became official, many of his colleagues have approached him to congratulate him.
database.raw_text:
------- Mr. Bingham’s promotion became official, many of his colleagues have
approached him to congratulate him.
(A) Despite
(B) Still
(C) Since
(D) During
database.explanation:
Mr. Bingham’s promotion became official结构完整，因
此横线处应填入从属连词。备选答案中只有(C)Since(自从)是从属连词。当
备选答案既有介词也有连词时，可观察横线后跟的是名词短语还是具有完整
结构的句子，用排除法判断答案，可以节约解题时间。
